genotype.statement: Heterozygous NM_014847.4:c.1964dup/p.Leu656SerfsTer3 agrees with sourceTablesS1/S2 and pedigree.

segregation.statement: Authors report de novo occurrence based on quad sequencing including an unaffected sibling; pedigree parents negative. Parentage confirmation/mosaic exclusion not separately documented.

phase.statement: Single heterozygous candidate reported de novo; no biallelic phase question.
limitations: Parent-of-origin not established; no complete exclusion of low-level mosaicism.

causal_confidence.statement: Authors propose UBAP2L haploinsufficiency-associated NDD based on12cases, selected patient-cell/construct assays and mouse models. This individual frameshift was not directly assayed.

Unblinded mandatoryHANDOFF exposure declared; no caseoutcome files consulted.
Full main text, figures, main table, both supplement PDF versions, all12 clinical case columns and all8 workbook sheets actually read. No remaining component-reading gaps.

Internal source issues: no other pathogenic variants assertion conflicts withTGFB3 inTableS2 M67; main AS4mg/kg versusmethods4mg/g; anxiety wording anxiolytic-like conflicts with described avoidance; no protocol executed.

UBAP2L Data S5: enrichment is not uniform across all sets/subsets; SG-core DDG2P P=0.09469306 and FMRP P=1. Data S6 lists 40,853 source samples across WES/WGS cohorts; reading that source list is not independent duplicate-cohort exclusion or reanalysis. Original and corrected PDFs both read; v2 adds Data S1–S8 captions, with no resolving change to Family12 other-positive-findings conflict.

S8 row56 reports UBAP2L enrichment from 7 historical DNMs (4LGD/3MIS): CH LGD FDR=.006086279, FWER=1; DenovolyzeR LGD FDR=.252444324. Gene-set/model-specific enrichment is not independent patient-level pathogenicity proof. Missing statistics and source significance flags were retained, not recomputed.

S7 all3412 rows,A:S actually read, with repeated samples/studies and literal duplicate transcript annotations retained (e.g.DDX3X rows3318–3322); entries include synonymous/common background variants. No duplicate-cohort exclusion, independent annotation normalization, coordinate liftover or causal reclassification was performed.
